journey.title: When did Grandma move to Đà Nẵng?
journey.stage1: Two accounts remember the same move differently. Ask the assistant to show what does not add up.
journey.stage2: The page is torn because the evidence disagrees. The assistant can ask; only the family can answer.
journey.stage3: The family's words are now attached to the memory. They may confirm a year, or leave it honestly unresolved.
journey.stage4: The assistant's bilingual draft keeps the weakest certainty and every source it stands on.
journey.promptFlag: Read Grandma's move to Đà Nẵng. If the two years conflict, flag the conflict and tell me what the evidence says without choosing a winner.
journey.promptAsk: Ask Uncle Ba whether the 1974 photograph was taken before or after Grandma moved. Link the question to both the open conflict and the 1972 claim. Ask it in Vietnamese and English.
journey.promptDraft: Read the family's answer, then draft a short bilingual story card about Grandma. Cite only existing claims and keep every uncertainty visible.
journey.promptRead: Read Grandma's completed story and explain which family words and documents it stands on.
journey.askAssistant: Ask ChatGPT or Codex in the browser:
journey.manualFallback: This browser is not offering site tools. You can still use this prompt with the manual tools in Backstage:
journey.reviewed: A person has read this draft and checked it against the cited sources.
journey.unknownIsOkay: The family does not have to choose. “We don't know yet” remains a truthful ending.

road.wedged: The way is blocked: this stretch is still unsettled.
road.locked: Out of reach: something unsettled lies before it.

forest.locked: out of reach, something ahead does not add up
forest.agentHolds_one: The assistant is holding {{count}} tool — it changes with what you open
forest.agentHolds_other: The assistant is holding {{count}} tools — they change with what you open

front.name: The front page
front.nothingAskedYet: Write a question on the page beside this one.
front.nothingFound: No page in the book speaks to this.
front.noSurerThan: The answer is no surer than the weakest page among these.

tear.why: The archive disagrees with itself. No tool available to the agent can close this — only a person can decide.
tear.cannotClose: The book will not close here.
tear.needPerson: A person has to be named. The database refuses the write without one.

refused.heading: This page will not turn
refused.cannotTurn: The book stops here until a person settles it.
refused.ask: Ask the assistant to settle it

backstage.title: Backstage
backstage.intro: The machinery under the archive: the tools the agent is holding, and every operation that has happened.
backstage.noServer: No server. The whole of Postgres runs in this tab and is stored in your browser.
backstage.toolsWhy: The same handlers an agent reaches over WebMCP. Tools appear and disappear with what you have open — that is the point.
backstage.actorWhy: Not cosmetic: the database assumes a different role for each, and the agent’s holds no privilege to confirm a claim or close a conflict.

evidence.none: No source has been attached to this claim yet.
evidence.noEvidence: This claim rests on nothing yet.

photo.stays: The photograph never leaves your machine. The archive keeps only its date and its filename.

audit.heading: Audit trail
audit.intro: Every operation leaves a line, including the ones that were refused.

did.link_claim_to_source: attached a source to a claim

app.tagline: An evidence-first family archive. The agent may find a contradiction; it may not settle one.
app.ephemeral: Private browsing: this archive lives in memory only and will be gone when you close the tab.
